Enumerate possible \(a\in\{\pm1,\pm2\}\).

- \(a=1\): \(xy=2\), so \(|y-x|=1\), giving \(\Delta=1^2\cdot1^2=1\).
- \(a=-1\): \(xy=-2\), so \(|y-x|=3\), giving \(\Delta=(-1)^2\cdot3^2=9\).
- \(a=2\): \(xy=1\), so \(x=y\), not allowed.
- \(a=-2\): \(xy=-1\), so \(|y-x|=2\), giving \(\Delta=(-2)^2\cdot2^2=16\).

The maximum is therefore

\[
\boxed{16}
\]
